item.title: Lilly Trulicity Fraud Lawsuit
item.description:
• Summary: Eli Lilly has filed a lawsuit accusing church‑linked pharmacies, wholesalers, and other entities of defrauding the company of more than $200 million involving the diabetes drug Trulicity (dulaglutide). The lawsuit alleges systematic billing and rebate fraud schemes. The case highlights ongoing concerns about drug distribution integrity and manufacturer exposure to fraudulent claims.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma

item.title: RA Capital SPAC Biotech Merger
item.description:
• Summary: RA Capital Management is merging its special‑purpose acquisition company (SPAC) with a Chinese biotech company, according to BioPharma Dive. The deal involves a specific pricing structure and reflects the continued use of SPAC vehicles to bring private biotechs to public markets, particularly cross‑border transactions involving China‑based firms.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: BioPharma Dive

item.title: Incyte AI Deals
item.description:
• Summary: Incyte has signed partnership deals with Genesis Molecular AI and Edison Scientific, leveraging artificial intelligence to accelerate drug discovery and development.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News

item.title: BMS Texas Campus and Novartis Slovenia
item.description:
• Summary: Bristol Myers Squibb (BMS) is planning a new corporate campus in Texas, signaling expansion of its operational footprint in the U.S. Meanwhile, Novartis is seeking to evict a tenant from its Slovenian campus, indicating a consolidation or repurposing of its European real estate assets. Both moves reflect strategic resource allocation in the competitive biopharma landscape.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News

item.title: Vaxart Shareholder Battle
item.description:
• Summary: Vaxart is engaged in a contentious battle with shareholders over a proposed stock split. The company is seeking shareholder support to approve the split, which is aimed at stabilizing its stock price and avoiding delisting. Opponents argue the move could dilute existing shares and reflect poorly on the company's financial health.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: BioSpace

item.title: Biopharma AI Integration Deals
item.description:
• Summary: Lilly, Bristol Myers Squibb (BMS), and Incyte have each struck separate deals to integrate artificial intelligence into their drug discovery and development pipelines. These partnerships aim to leverage AI for target identification, biomarker discovery, and clinical trial optimization, reflecting a broader trend of biopharma companies embracing digital innovation to accelerate R&D.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: BioSpace

item.title: Liminatus CAR-T Acquisition
item.description:
• Summary: Struggling biotech Liminatus has agreed to acquire Innocs AI in a stock deal valued at $320 million. The acquisition is intended to bolster Liminatus's pipeline with Innocs's CAR-T therapy platform, combining artificial intelligence-driven discovery with cell therapy manufacturing. The deal aims to turn around Liminatus's fortunes by tapping into the growing market for engineered T-cell treatments.
  • MoAs: Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-cell (CAR-T) therapy (modality); specific target not disclosed
  • Sources: Fierce Biotech

item.title: Lilly Engage Bio Acquisition
item.description:
• Summary: Eli Lilly has acquired Engage Bio for $202 million, gaining access to its non-viral DNA delivery platform. The technology enables safer and more efficient delivery of genetic material for gene therapies and cell therapies. The acquisition reinforces Lilly's commitment to genetic medicine and expands its toolkit for developing next-generation therapies.
  • MoAs: N/A (platform technology; non-viral DNA delivery)
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology

item.title: Fujifilm iPSC Facility
item.description:
• Summary: Fujifilm has opened a new manufacturing facility dedicated to induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) production. The facility aims to support the growing demand for iPSC-derived therapies, including cell therapies for regenerative medicine and drug discovery applications. This expansion positions Fujifilm as a key contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) in the stem cell space.
  • MoAs: Induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) technology (modality)
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology

item.title: BMS Anthropic Claude AI
item.description:
• Summary: Bristol Myers Squibb has implemented Anthropic's Claude AI to enhance drug discovery and operational efficiency. The partnership leverages AI to accelerate research and development.
